title: The Black Whale

timeline.event: Departure of the Black Whale from the port of Kakin
Beyond Netero is imprisoned in Tier 1 VVIP prison
Kurapika and Leorio join the Zodiacs on board

keyEvents: Introduction to the Black Whale and its mission
Kurapika and Leorio join the Zodiacs team
description: Introductory chapter presenting the Black Whale ship, its 6-tier structure, and the main players in the arc. The ship leaves the port of Kakin with on board the 14 princes, their factions, and the Zodiacs responsible for monitoring Beyond Netero.

title: The Mission

timeline.event: Meeting of the princes on Tier 1 - Official announcement of the War of Succession
Explanation of the rules: the Urn of the Seed will choose the successor
The factions begin to organize themselves in their respective chambers

keyEvents: Announcement of the War of Succession by King Nasubi
Presentation of the 14 princes and their initial strategies
Distribution of rooms in Tiers 1 and 2
description: King Nasubi Hui Guo Rou officially announces the start of the War of Succession. The 14 princes (and Princess Woble) divide up into their respective districts on Tiers 1 and 2. Each prince begins to implement his strategy to survive and be chosen by the Urn of the Seed.

title: Initiative

timeline.event: Hisoka arrives in Tier 5 and begins his hunt
The Phantom Troupe settles in Tier 5
Premieres tensions entre factions mafieuses (Xi-Yu, Cha-R, Heil-Ly)
Kurapika begins teaching Nen to Queen Oito and training Woble's guards

keyEvents: Arrival of Hisoka and start of his hunt by the Phantom Troupe
Installation of mafia factions on lower thirds
Premieres alliances et tensions entre factions
description: Hisoka arrives on the Black Whale and immediately begins his hunt. The Phantom Troupe, with Chrollo and Nobunaga, settles in Tier 5 to organize the hunt. Meanwhile, Kurapika begins training Queen Oito and Prince Woble's guards in Nen, while monitoring the movements of the other factions.

title: Parasite

timeline.event: Assassination of Momoze (12th Princess) in room 1012
Marayam (13th Prince) activates his Nen ability to isolate room 1013
Benjamin (1st Prince) imposes Martial Law from room 1001
Camilla (2nd Princess) attempts to murder Benjamin and is imprisoned
Tserriednich (4th Prince) manipulates the Heil-Ly to sow chaos
Kacho (10th Princess) and Fugetsu (11th Princess) try to escape with Melody
Hisoka assassinates two members of the Phantom Troupe in Tier 5
Kurapika uses Little Eye (cockroaches) to spy on other factions

keyEvents: Hisoka kills two members of the Phantom Troupe
Tentative de fuite de Kacho et Fugetsu
Debut de l'espionnage massif de Kurapika
description: The war intensifies with the first killings and the first major strategies. Benjamin takes military control, Hisoka takes action, and Kurapika activates his spy network. Mafia factions begin to play an active role in the conflict, manipulating the princes and their guards.

title: Martial Law

timeline.event: Benjamin strengthens Martial Law with Balsamilco Might
Rihan is transferred from Benjamin to Sale-sale then to Tubeppa
Tubeppa (5th Princess) transforms her room 1005 into a laboratory

description: Benjamin consolidates his military power. Martial Law applies strictly on the ship. Transfers of guards between princes become a common strategy.

title: Mafia Wars

timeline.event: The Xi-Yu (Hinrigh) family operates on the lower thirds
The Cha-R family (Ken'i Wang) tactically allies with the Phantom Troupe
Hisoka negotiates with the Xi-Yu mafia

description: Mafia factions become major players in the conflict. The Phantom Troupe allies with the Cha-R against Hisoka, while the latter negotiates with the Xi-Yu.

title: Heil-Ly's Gambit

timeline.event: Morena Prudo activates 'Et tu, Juliet' on the ship
Luini uses his dimensional ability to pass through armored walls
Tserriednich uses the Heil-Ly to sow chaos

keyEvents: Activation d'Et tu, Juliet par Morena
description: The Heil-Ly family deploys their Nen infection strategy. Morena Prudo activates her kill-rewarding ability, while Luini uses her dimensional powers to infiltrate secure areas.

title: Truth or Falsehood

timeline.event: Furykov confronts Beyond about his sacrificial curse
Kurapika and Oito prepare a message for the mainland
The royal camps respond to special martial law
timeline.location: Black Whale 1 - Tier 1 Royal Residential Sector

timeline.event: Ridge subdues Kanjidol during martial law
timeline.location: Black Whale 1 - Tier 1 Royal Residential Sector

keyEvents: Furykov analyzes and confronts Beyond about his curse
Conflicting orders reshape the royal camps
description: A flashback two months before departure shows Furykov analyzing the sacrificial curse placed on him at birth and confronting Beyond after the Seed Urn Ceremony assigns it a royal target. In the present, Kurapika and Oito prepare a message for the mainland before martial law spreads and Ridge halts Kanjidol's assault.
